headline: Loan and securities sales drive a reported hit; core steady
summary_short: Truist's Q3 2026 diluted EPS was $0.56 after $0.60 per share of strategic-action costs; adjusted EPS was $1.16 (+12% y/y) and NIM rose to 3.00%.
summary_long: Reported results reflect completion of the Regional Acceptance Corporation loan sale and a follow-on securities repositioning, including a $1.4B pre-tax loss on securities sales and a $581M reserve recapture. Adjusted revenue of $5.3B was stable, with net interest income up 1.1% and record wealth management income. Net charge-offs were 0.77% including 39 bps from RAC. Deposits ended at $413.2B, up 0.9%. CET1 was 10.7%. On October 14 Truist agreed to sell $7.7B of LightStream loans to Carlyle.
confidence_notes: The shard's sourceLink pointed at an 8-K announcing leadership appointments, not earnings; the earnings release was located by one web search and read on sec.gov. Adjusted figures exclude the securities loss, reserve recapture and RAC-sale impacts. Q/q revenue and net income changes computed from the three-quarter table; adjusted y/y growth as stated.

drivers.explanation: A $0.90 per share loss on AFS securities sales and $0.06 of RAC sale impacts were partly offset by $0.36 per share from loan loss reserve recapture.
Net interest income rose 1.1% q/q and the margin widened two basis points.
Noninterest income was hit by losses on the RAC loan sale and securities repositioning, partly offset by record wealth management income.
CEO said the actions strengthen risk, liquidity and funding and free capacity to invest; the company remains confident in its ROTCE targets.
